capabilities: Open and edit PGN files in a dedicated chess view with a variation tree
Embed interactive boards in notes via chess and fen code blocks
Analyze positions and play against the built-in Stockfish engine
Navigate games with keyboard shortcuts across branches and forks
Export boards as PNG snapshots and animated GIFs
extras: The listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. UI is translated into eight languages. The bundled Stockfish engine runs as WASM, so no external installation is needed.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view, play through, annotate or analyze chess games stored as PGN files or embedded in notes.

relations.evidence: Engine: Stockfish 18 — WASM build from nmrugg/stockfish.js
combine it with a fullscreen plugin (e.g. obsidian-full-screen-cross-platform-plugin)

summary: Renders interactive chess boards in notes with PGN variation trees, position editing, Chess960 support and a built-in Stockfish engine for analysis and play.
